description: This file defines the WorkspaceDeleteForm class, a Drupal form for deleting workspaces, including handling child workspaces and related revisions.

classes.name: WorkspaceDeleteForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for deleting workspace entities, handling child workspaces and associated revisions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with required services from the container.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the form with entity repository, workspace tracker, repository, bundle info, and time services.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the delete confirmation form, checking for child workspaces and listing revisions to be deleted.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns a description message indicating the delete action is irreversible and includes content deletion info.
